findings.required_change: Package deterministic implementation/build provenance as an installed resource or derive it from stable packaged metadata such as an embedded manifest bound to wheel RECORD. Provenance must not depend on a source-checkout ancestor and must remain installation-attested and re-sign resistant.
mechanical_closure_tests: Build the candidate wheel, install or extract it into a clean directory, change outside the source checkout, and import with isolated sys.path; every built-in implementation digest must resolve successfully.
Assert source-checkout and clean-installed provenance values are byte-for-byte identical for every closed adapter entry and exactly match the installed registry.
From the clean installed artifact, construct the exact installation-attested factory and issue and dispatch every closed adapter through its valid bounded path.
Retain one-field and fully self-consistent re-sign substitutions for implementation digest/ref, capability, operation, policy and registry; all must reject before adapter issue or external call.
